description:
In this video, I'm walking you through two powerful new tech advancements working together seamlessly. First, we're diving into OmniNFT, a negative-aware fine-tuned LoRA model that dramatically improves audio and video synchronization for LTX Video generation. Then, I'm showing you how to automate your entire video creation pipeline using Hermes AI agents, ComfyUI workflows, and a custom Visual Storyline system that lets you build complete stories from scratch.

This tutorial is designed for creators working with AI video generation tools, especially those familiar with ComfyUI, LTX Video, and diffusion models. Whether you're a filmmaker exploring AI-assisted storytelling, a YouTuber building automated content pipelines, or an AI enthusiast looking to streamline your workflow between image generation, keyframing, and video synthesis, this guide will give you practical, hands-on techniques you can apply immediately.

What makes this important is that you can now achieve human-in-the-loop control while scaling production efficiency. Instead of manually handling every single step from story conception to final video output, you get structured AI agent assistance that handles the heavy lifting while you maintain creative oversight. This saves computing resources, reduces failed generations, and ensures your story stays consistent across multiple scenes and shots.

Resources: 

OmniNFT
https://github.com/zghhui/OmniNFT
https://huggingface.co/zghhui/OmniNFT

Hermes Agent
https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent

Attached "visual-storyline-pipeline" Skill and pipeline I have testing with, also 2 ComfyUI API workflows in this video demo. 
https://www.patreon.com/posts/158869436/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=20260521


Video Timeline & Chapters:

00:00 - Introduction to Omni NFT & Video-Audio Syncing
00:44 - How to Download and Setup Omni NFT (Hugging Face)
01:18 - Automating Video Creation with Hermes Agents & Comfy UI
01:53 - Setting Up the LTX Workflow & Prompt Relay
02:38 - Exporting Comfy UI Workflows for API Use
03:00 - The Visual Storyline Pipeline: Step-by-Step Guide
04:10 - Human-in-the-Loop: Why Involvement Matters in AI Workflows
05:08 - Phase 1: Narrative & Character List Creation (Text-First)
06:24 - Phase 2: Image Generation & Reference Keyframes
07:45 - Interacting with Hermes Agent for Real-Time Adjustments
08:58 - Reviewing Character Sheets and Multi-Angle Consistency
10:10 - Modular Workflow Design: Simplifying the Process
11:10 - Phase 3: Moving to Video Generation & Scene Review
12:44 - Final Video Demo: Negative-Aware Fine-Tuning in Action
13:32 - Visual Story Showcase: "The Garden Mystery"
